The Steelmen[http://www.footballcrests.com/clubs/motherwell-fc Motherwell F.C. ] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170512021059/http://www.footballcrests.com/clubs/motherwell-fc |date=12 May 2017 }}, ''Football Crests'' | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1886|5|17}}{{harvnb|Wilson|2008|p=86}} | ground = [[Fir Park]][http://www.motherwellfc.co.uk/the-club/fir-park/ Fir Park] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170410122813/http://www.motherwellfc.co.uk/the-club/fir-park/ |date=10 April 2017 }}, ''Stadium on Motherwell FC Website'' | capacity = {{SPFL-stadiums|motherwell}} | chairman = Kyrk Macmillan | manager = [[Alfred Johansson (football manager)|Alfred Johansson]] | league = {{Scottish football updater|Motherwe}} | season = {{Scottish football updater|Motherwe2}} | position = {{Scottish football updater|Motherwe3}} | website = {{URL|http://www.motherwellfc.co.uk}} | pattern_la1 = _motherwell2627h | pattern_b1 = _motherwell2627h | pattern_ra1 = _motherwell2627h | pattern_sh1 = _motherwell2627h | pattern_so1 = _motherwell2627hl | leftarm1 = FFBE00 | body1 = FFBE00 | rightarm1 = FFBE00 | shorts1 = ffffff | socks1 =FFBE00 | pattern_la2 = _motherwell2627a | pattern_b2 = _motherwell2627a | pattern_ra2 = _motherwell2627a | pattern_sh2 = _motherwell2627a | pattern_so2 = _motherwell2627al | leftarm2 = 9e0000 | body2 = 9e0000 | rightarm2 = 9e0000 | shorts2 = 9e0000 | socks2 = 9e0000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = | current = 2026–27 Motherwell F.C. season }} '''Motherwell Football Club''' is a Scottish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Motherwell]], [[North Lanarkshire]], which plays in the {{Scottish football updater|Motherwe}}. Motherwell have not dropped out of the top flight of Scottish football since 1985, and have lifted one trophy in that time – the [[Scottish Cup]] [[1991 Scottish Cup final|in 1991]].{{cite web|title=Motherwell 4 – 3 Dundee United|url=http://progs.fairlyoriginal.com/motherwell-4-3-dundee-united|work=fairleyoriginal.com|access-date=3 September 2012|archive-date=4 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140504001021/http://progs.fairlyoriginal.com/motherwell-4-3-dundee-united|url-status=live}} Owing to the town's history of steel production, the club is nicknamed '''"the Steelmen"'''; or "the Well" for short. Clad in their traditional claret and amber, Motherwell play their home matches at [[Fir Park]] and have done so since 1896. The club's main rivals over the years have been [[Hamilton Academical F.C.|Hamilton Academical]] and [[Airdrieonians F.C.|Airdrieonians]], due in part to their close geographical proximities. These matches are known as the [[Lanarkshire derby]]. The club have won four major trophies in domestic football: the [[List of Scottish football champions|Scottish League title]] in [[1931–32 Scottish Division One|1931–32]], the [[Scottish Cup]] in [[1952 Scottish Cup final|1951–52]] and [[1991 Scottish Cup final|1990–91]], and the [[Scottish League Cup]] in [[1950 Scottish League Cup final|1950–51]]. ''[[Sports Illustrated]]'' has suggested Motherwell's fans as the originators of the "[[Viking Thunder Clap]]", a supporting chant eventually popularised by the fans of the [[Iceland national football team]], where fans stay silent and let out loud synchronised claps seconds apart, gradually speeding up; the chant received wider international attention during [[UEFA Euro 2016|Euro 2016]].{{cite magazine |last1=West |first1=Jenna |title=What Does Iceland's Skol Viking Clap Mean? |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/2018/06/15/iceland-skol-clap-meaning-explained-world-cup-history |access-date=6 July 2020 |magazine=Sports Illustrated |publisher=ABG-SI LLC |date=15 June 2018 |archive-date=6 July 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200706044815/https://www.si.com/soccer/2018/06/15/iceland-skol-clap-meaning-explained-world-cup-history|url-status=live }}"}}
